name: Ari Lerner
headline: Founder, MVM • Building secure execution infrastructure for AI agents and untrusted code

narrative.hook: I build the infrastructure beneath the prompt: secure execution boundaries, deterministic runtimes, and systems that make powerful software easier to trust.
narrative.body:
MVM is where most of my time goes: a security-first microVM runtime for AI agents and untrusted code. Hologram is an object-first runtime for portable, deterministic computation; UOR is research into semantic, content-addressed identity. I work from applied mathematics and Lean 4 proofs through Rust, kernels, hypervisors, protocols, and product.

Across more than three decades I have built production systems at AWS, led AI, platform, and cybersecurity work inside regulated banking, scaled newline.io — formerly Fullstack.io — to 50K+ students and $2M+ in annual revenue, authored or co-authored 9+ technical books with 100K+ copies in six languages, and taught engineers across five continents. The through-line is simple: go one layer deeper, make authority explicit, and design the blast radius before failure does it for you.

experience.title: Founder
highlights: Architected MVM, a security-first microVM platform where workloads boot their own kernel with no guest network device at all — the host originates every connection, so default-deny egress is mechanically enforced rather than documented.

Defined 18 numbered security claims — signed execution plans, chain-signed audit logs, dm-verity boot, sealed production images — each bound to executable witnesses so a claim cannot regress without failing CI.
Built secret substitution and PII redaction over vsock so raw credentials never reach the guest, including detection of secrets split across frame boundaries.
Designed the AI-agent containment surface: run-shaped capability grants that give autonomous agents somewhere to execute model-generated code without trusting it.
Built RoboRef, a real-time computer vision system for youth sports — referee and gameplay tracking with autonomous camera control and low-latency edge inference.

experience.title: Founder
highlights: Authored the mathematical core — a 12,288-element (48×256) prime-structure boundary with a 96-class resonance algebra, unity constraints, and conservation invariants — formalized in Lean 4 and exported over a stable C ABI to Rust, Go, Python, and Node.

Co-inventor on the patent-pending inference method — "Systems and Methods for Holographic Computing", U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 63/976,830: identical work is content-addressed once and never recomputed, and finite-domain functions dispatch as O(1) lookup tables — ~28× on bf16 GELU, bit-identical.

Invented a transformerless inference path: transformer language models cross-compiled into multiplication-free artifacts whose entire runtime arithmetic is add / shift / xor / compare / table-read, at 28.1× compression and a certified residual.
Built hologram-ai, compiling Hugging Face models into self-contained applications with deterministic CPU-only inference — no MatMul, no GPU, no ONNX, no network at runtime.

Contribute to MIT's Project NANDA (Networked Agents and Decentralized AI): authored the UOR-NANDA interoperability profile inside the UOR Standards Program and presented "The Object Internet" at NANDA 2026.

projects.name: Hologram — O(1) Neural Inference
projects.desc: Constant-time neural inference: identical work is content-addressed once and never recomputed, and finite-domain functions become O(1) lookup tables (~28× on bf16 GELU, bit-identical). The same archive runs on x86_64, WebAssembly, and ARM bare metal.

projects.name: F₁ — Lean 4 Arithmetic Geometry
projects.desc: A Lean 4 research base mechanizing the fibre square Spec Z × Spec Z over F₁, whose Hodge-index positivity would yield the Riemann Hypothesis. The geometry is machine-checked; RH itself is stated as open, not claimed.

projects.name: UOR — uor.foundation
projects.desc: A formal ontology for content-addressed, symmetric, multi-metric object spaces over Z/(2ⁿ)Z — 16 namespaces, 213 classes, 438 properties — generated into typed Rust traits, JSON-LD, and Turtle. Ships with PRISM, a universal coordinate system for information.

projects.name: MVM — Security-First MicroVM Platform
projects.desc: Runs OCI images, Nix flakes, or decorated functions in hardware-isolated microVMs with no guest NIC at all: default-deny egress, signed execution plans, chain-signed audit logs, and secret substitution over vsock — 18 claims, each enforced by CI.

projects.name: AgentZero
projects.desc: A fast, secure AI agent runtime in Rust — deny-by-default policies, encrypted vault, PII redaction, audit trails, and a WASM plugin sandbox.

projects.name: transformerless / uor-r4
projects.desc: Cross-compiles a transformer LLM into a table-native artifact whose entire arithmetic is add/shift/xor/compare/table-read — 28.1× compression at a certified residual.
